notes: Macro-library repo with no callers; wrote a caller exercising %uccc (U-statistics CCC) from rm_ccc_macro_v2.sas with 16-subject mock blood-pressure longitudinal data (2 methods, 3 time points). Two Jenner IML adaptations applied: (1) 'read all var _num_' instead of 'read all var{quoted}' due to parser gap; (2) PROBIT(0.975) replaced with constant 1.95996. The variance-components path (%ccc_lon) depends on PROC MIXED ODS output tables read via 'read all var{string}' which Jenner does not yet support.
